headline: U.S. food importer sues to block new tariffs on Canadian goods
summary: Gellert Global Group filed a lawsuit to stop the administration's latest trade tariffs on imports originating from Canada.
why: Tariffs increase the operational costs for import-heavy businesses, potentially squeezing profit margins and raising consumer prices.
